name: meeting-notes
title: Meeting notes
summary: Turns a raw transcript into decisions, action items and open questions.
blurb: One LlmNode and nothing else: no tools, no mounts, no files to point it at. Paste a transcript in and get minutes out, under three fixed headings. It is the shortest path from an installed heddle to a run that did something useful, and the flow is small enough to read in one screen — which makes it the one to copy when you want a prompt of your own on the same rails.

input.transcript:
Priya: the checkout latency work — are we shipping Thursday or not?
Marco: not Thursday. The cache warm-up is still flaky under load.
Priya: fine, next Tuesday then. Marco, can you own the warm-up fix?
Marco: yes. I'll have it in review by Friday.
Dana: someone needs to tell support the date moved.
Priya: agreed, we'll sort out who after this call.
Dana: also, do we still need the old batch path once this lands?
Marco: not sure. Nobody has checked what still calls it.
